card.name: Monitoring wording in interaction sections
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction and precaution text that lead into monitoring or lab testing, such as 'monitoring', 'monitor', 'Test' after 'Drug/Laboratory', and linking words or commas around co-administration advice.

modes.description: The word monitor or monitoring after clinical, closely or periodic advice.

modes.label: Linking words in advice
modes.description: A preposition or comma in a sentence about timing of checks or separating drugs.
modes.example: Periodic CBC, differential, and platelet counts are advised<< during>> prolonged therapy.
